name: appelli_db
description: Nx monorepo for a university exam-scheduling system (appelli_db): teachers within a degree programme coordinate exam dates within a planning window configured by the secretariat. The backend is a NestJS + TypeORM/PostgreSQL API and the frontend is a React 19 + Vite single-page app styled with TailwindCSS and shadcn/Radix UI. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
